summary: Kaan, a Turkish backend engineer in Berlin who cycles to work, rents a flat in Neukölln, juggles residence-permit paperwork, expects family visits from Turkey and is saving for a house deposit with his partner Clara.

items.title: Ablası geliyor
items.text: 20 Ekim'de kullanıcı, ablası Derya'nın çocuklarıyla birlikte 18 Aralık Cuma günü İzmir'den Berlin'e geleceğini ve 27 Aralık'a kadar kalacaklarını söyledi.

items.title: Tax advisor
items.text: The user files the annual tax return with the help of a Steuerberater, Herr Albrecht, who charges a flat fee of €280.

items.title: Goethe B2 sınavı
items.text: 8 Ekim'de kullanıcı, Goethe B2 sınavının 28 Kasım Cumartesi sabahı 09:00'da olduğunu söyledi.

items.text: The user's previous flat in Wedding was managed by Hausverwaltung Kramer, and the €1,950 deposit from that flat has not been fully refunded yet.

items.text: ikisini S-Bahn'a yakınlığa göre kıyaslıyorum: Falkensee'de istasyona 9 dakika yürüyüş, Bernau'da 17 dakika

items.title: Bike insurance § 3
items.text: Bicycle theft insurance, section 3: Theft is covered only if the bike was locked with an approved lock worth at least €60 to a fixed object. The deductible is €50. Between 22:00 and 06:00 the bike is covered only if stored in a locked room.

items.title: Bike insurance § 5
items.text: Section 5: Theft must be reported to the police within 24 hours and to the insurer within seven days. The maximum payout is the replacement value, capped at €1,200.

items.title: Damlayan musluk
items.text: mutfak musluğu damlıyor, iki gündür sesi uyutmuyor, umarım bu hafta gelirler

items.title: Komşu Frau Lindqvist
items.text: üst kattaki komşu Frau Lindqvist cumartesi gecesi gürültü için özür diledi, kapıya kuru pasta bırakmış, çok tatlı

items.title: Bisiklet odası anahtarı
items.text: bisiklet odasının anahtarı kayboldu, yenisi 15 euro, Hausmeister Herr Böhm yedeğini cuma günü verecekmiş

items.title: Clara's bike
items.text: The user's partner Clara rides a green Dutch city bike with a front basket.

items.title: Rental agreement § 2
items.text: Rental agreement, § 2: The monthly cold rent is €900. Advance payments for heating and utilities are €280, so the total monthly payment is €1,180, due by the third working day of each month.

items.title: Rental agreement § 5
items.text: § 5: The tenant pays a security deposit of €2,700, which may be paid in three equal instalments. The landlord will place the deposit in a separate interest-bearing account.

items.title: Rental agreement § 8
items.text: § 8: The tenant may terminate the contract with a notice period of three months, delivered in writing and received by the third working day of the month. Subletting requires written consent.

items.title: Rental agreement § 11
items.text: § 11: Bicycles may be stored only in the bicycle room in the rear building. Quiet hours are 22:00 to 06:00 and all day on Sundays. Leaving the stairwell blocked is prohibited.

items.title: Lock contention bug
items.text: Spent the whole afternoon on a nasty lock contention problem in the billing service. Turned out a migration was holding an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock on the invoices table for 40 seconds.

items.title: Migration fix
items.text: Fix was creating the index concurrently and splitting the migration into two deploys. Marlene approved the PR within ten minutes, which is rare.

items.title: Meetup talk idea
items.text: Might propose a short talk about it at the Berlin Go meetup in January, if they'll have me.

items.title: Randevu sıkıntısı
items.text: Kullanıcı yabancılar dairesinden randevu almakta zorlanıyor; online sistemde boş yer genellikle altı hafta sonrasına çıkıyor.

items.title: Konjunktiv II
items.text: bu akşam Konjunktiv II alıştırmalarını yaptım, uzun cümlelerde hâlâ 'wäre' ile 'hätte'yi karıştırıyorum

items.title: Ziyaretçi vizesi listesi
items.text: Ebeveynler için ziyaretçi vizesi başvuru listesi: geçerli pasaportlar, en az 30.000 euro teminatlı seyahat sağlık sigortası, davet mektubu, gidiş-dönüş uçak rezervasyonu ve davet edenin kira sözleşmesinin kopyası.

items.title: Vize ücreti
items.text: Vize ücreti kişi başı 90 euro'dur ve başvuru sırasında kartla ödenir. Sonuç genellikle 10 ila 15 iş günü içinde bildirilir.

items.title: House deposit goal
items.text: The user is saving toward a house deposit (Eigenkapital) with a target of €60,000.

items.title: Eski depozito
items.text: 9 Ekim'de kullanıcı, eski dairenin ev yönetimi Hausverwaltung Kramer'in depozitodan kalan 750 euroyu 30 Kasım'a kadar hesabına yatıracağını söylediğini aktardı.

items.text: Kullanıcı çarşamba akşamları halk eğitim merkezinde (Volkshochschule) B2 seviyesi Almanca kursuna gidiyor.

items.title: Savings progress
items.text: Checked the numbers again: 27,400 saved so far, so about 32,600 still to go.

items.title: Transfer tax
items.text: Also the property transfer tax in Brandenburg is 6.5%, so on a 400k house that's another 26k just for Grunderwerbsteuer. Ouch.

items.title: Notary costs
items.text: Notary plus land registry will be another 1.5 to 2 percent. So realistically I need way more than the deposit.

items.title: Co-borrower question
items.text: Should ask Herr Neumann whether Clara's income can count too if we apply as co-borrowers.

items.title: Bike commute
items.text: The user cycles to the office, roughly 9 km along the Landwehrkanal, which takes about 28 minutes.

items.title: The user's bike
items.text: The user's bike is a second-hand grey Cube gravel bike bought for €450.

items.title: Permit card checklist
items.text: Checklist for replacing the residence permit card: valid passport, the current card, a registration certificate (Anmeldebestätigung) issued within the last three months, and one biometric photo in 35x45 mm format. The replacement fee is €67.

items.title: Booking portal tips
items.text: Appointments are released on the official booking portal on weekdays around 07:00, and cancelled slots often reappear around noon. If you cannot attend, cancel at least 24 hours before the appointment.

items.title: House viewing Bernau
items.text: On Saturday 17 October the user viewed a house in Bernau with an asking price of €410,000, four bedrooms and 120 square metres of living space.

items.title: Partner Clara
items.text: The user's partner Clara teaches at a primary school in Pankow and is slowly learning Turkish from the user.

items.title: Job
items.text: The user works as a backend engineer at Lumenform GmbH in Berlin, mostly writing Go services on top of PostgreSQL.

items.title: House viewing Falkensee
items.text: On Saturday 10 October the user viewed a house in Falkensee with an asking price of €395,000, three bedrooms and a large garden.

items.title: Immigration paperwork
items.text: Need to gather everything for the immigration office: passport, registration certificate, tenancy agreement, employer's letter and a biometric photo.

items.title: Employer letter
items.text: HR said they can issue the employer letter within three working days, I just have to ask on Slack.

items.title: Insurance confirmation
items.text: Also bring the health insurance confirmation, otherwise they'll send me home like last time lol

items.title: Office days
items.text: The user's office is in Friedrichshain; the team is expected on site on Tuesdays and Thursdays, and the other days are remote.

items.title: Current flat
items.text: The user rents a two-room flat in Neukölln near Weserstraße on the third floor, with a balcony facing the courtyard.

items.title: Mortgage broker
items.text: The user's mortgage broker is Herr Neumann, who advises having at least 20% equity before applying.
